tools.name: unpack
tools.description: Convert an .xlsx or .ods file into an FSA1 workbook directory — tabs become folders, each file's name is the A1 range it fills. Cells are files: read and edit them with your own file tools — this server has no write command.

dest.description: workbook directory to create; derived from the source name when omitted

decomposition.description: how a sheet is split into range files

strict.description: refuse rather than unpack a file the workbook cannot carry back identically

tools.name: pack
tools.description: Serialize an FSA1 workbook directory back into a single .xlsx file. Cells are files: read and edit them with your own file tools — this server has no write command.

dest.description: output .xlsx path; derived from the directory name when omitted

strict.description: refuse rather than write an .xlsx that leaves anything out -- a presentation declaration it cannot carry, or a figure that reaches no Excel chart; without it the file is written and each loss is named

force.description: overwrite a file already at the destination, given or derived; without it an occupied destination is refused. Either way the destination is written whole or left as it was

format.description: the format written; xlsx when omitted, and the extension a derived dest takes

tools.name: render
tools.description: Draw a workbook, a tab or a range as an ASCII grid, or as one standalone HTML document. Cells are files: read and edit them with your own file tools — this server has no write command.

target.description: <workbook>[/<tab>[/<A1 cell or range, or a defined name>]]

mode.description: combined shows a value and the formula behind it; ascii only, since html draws values and shows each formula in its formula bar

tools.name: check
tools.description: Lint a workbook, a tab or a range: broken references, overlapping ranges, malformed filenames, cycles. Cells are files: read and edit them with your own file tools — this server has no write command.

target.description: <workbook>[/<tab>[/<A1 cell or range, or a defined name>]]

xlsx.description: also report what an .xlsx export will not carry, writing nothing

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Evaluate an ad-hoc formula against a workbook without writing it anywhere. Cells are files: read and edit them with your own file tools — this server has no write command.

target.description: <workbook>[/<tab>[/<A1 cell or range, or a defined name>]]

formula.description: an =formula, evaluated in the target's scope

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Walk one cell's dependency chain, upstream to its inputs or downstream to what it feeds. Cells are files: read and edit them with your own file tools — this server has no write command.

depth.description: how many levels to walk; unbounded when omitted
